Name: Frog Decorations
Author: skellady
Description:
[size=5]Information:[/size]

This mod adds cute little frogs and a few paintings using [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/4112039]PeacefulEnd[/url]'s framework, [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]. 

Placing the objects/paintings will randomly pick one of the textures, however, if you'd like to set a specific color to your frogs, you'd need to buy the Paint Bucket Tool (added by AT) at Robin's shop. To use the paint bucket, click on the object while equipping the bucket and pick the texture of your choice. For more information on this tool, check PeacefulEnd's wiki on it [url=https://github.com/Floogen/AlternativeTextures/wiki/Paint-Bucket-Tool]here[/url]. 

[size=5]Installation: [/size]

1. Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI
[/url]2. Install the latest version of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]
3. Install the mod (manual download is recommended over vortex/mod managers)
4. Unzip the file, place the folder in your Mods folder
5. Launch your game and enjoy! 

[size=5]Extra:[/size]

- The objects that get replaced with the frog decorations are: 
For the objects: 
- Decorative Bowl
- Model Ship
- Globe

For the paintings: 
- Highway 89
- 1000 Years From Now
- A Night On Eco Hill
- Calico Falls
- Foliage Print
- Frozen Dreams
- Kite Master 95
- Land Of Clay

(All of these items can be acquired from the furniture catalog or the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/93]CJB Item Spawner[/url])

Downloads.Description: Added 3 new frogs and tweaked the sprites to look squishier.
